list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them.
note: Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, and names its sources. A source is cited, never copied. Grade note: Maximum Withdrawal is listed Silver here — KeenGamer, Insider Gaming, Radio Times and Exophase/PSNProfiles all say Silver; only Push Square lists Bronze.

vice-city-hub.label: GTA Vice City Hub — Achievements and Trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then strangers and activities, and leave the long grinds (stunts, the shooting range, WAiNK) for last so the counter trophies tick over while you clean up.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end — it is the game's first story beat, so you cannot miss it. Follow the prompts the game gives you and the trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies pop as the story closes each chapter, so just keep playing the main path — nothing here is missable and nothing needs a special setup.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by playing its story missions in order. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks when the chapter closes, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. By now the story has opened up Vice City itself — keep following the main missions and the trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Before you push into the final mission, use this point to clear side content: the optional Chapter 4 mission that opens the bank vaults lives here, and it feeds the Maximum Withdrawal trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the last story beat, so it pops at the end of the campaign — and the open world stays open afterwards, so nothing is locked off by finishing the story. Do your missable and one-shot trophies before this only if a guide tells you to; the story itself needs no special care.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It comes early in the story — play the main missions in order and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions lay out their own plan step by step, so follow the objectives the game shows and the trophy pops when the job is done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A named story mission like the others in this set — play the campaign in order and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. No preparation needed — it unlocks by playing the story through.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Expect the airport to stay a useful place afterwards — the unscheduled-departure trophy also lives at VCIA.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named story-mission trophies — once it pops, only the finale and the 100% gold remain on the story side.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's own checklist — story, stranger strands, activities and collectibles together. KeenGamer calls it the hardest trophy in the set and EGamers agrees, so treat it as the real platinum gate: the platinum cannot pop before this one does. Use the in-game checklist to see what is left and work this guide's stage 6 clean-up list against it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near misses and airtime all count, and they accumulate across the whole game. Stunt whenever you drive instead of saving it for a grind: bikes and fast cars off ramps build the total fastest, and by the time you finish the story you should be well on your way.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — KeenGamer counts nine. Sample everything early (races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and challenges) so you know which ones you enjoy before the long grinds begin.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work one weapon class at a time: gold needs speed and accuracy together, so learn each range's target pattern on a practice run before you chase the medal. This is one of the two silvers most guides name as a grind, so spread it across the playthrough.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's corners before you push for the win — a clean racing line beats raw speed on a drone, and each location is its own event, so a loss at one place costs you nothing at the others.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix street, off-road and water races; winning opens harder fields, so rotate through the race types instead of farming one favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are timing-based: watch the line tension, reel in the windows the game shows you, and do not fight the fish when the line is taut.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Pick the shortest cabinet you can find, learn its pattern over a couple of tries, and play it to the end — one full clear is all it takes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission — finish his whole stranger strand. Stranger missions appear as you explore Leonida; follow Andy's strand through each job until the last one, and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Same pattern as the other stranger finales: work through Kenton's strand job by job and the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Finish Billy's strand to its last job; stranger strands unlock as you explore, so sweep the map between story chapters to find them.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. There are more than eight strands in the game, so you can pick the ones you enjoy — each strand ends with a finale mission, and the four named finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward the eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Work Randy's strand to its last job; like the other stranger finales it pops at the end of the strand, not at any one step.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. The last of the five named stranger finales — finish Tyrone's strand and the trophy pops with the final job.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — KeenGamer counts 18. This is the one trophy guide sites flag as possibly missable: GTABase and PowerPyx (reported by EGamers) both warn it may be the only missable trophy in the game, so meditate at every spot the moment you find one instead of leaving them for a clean-up pass. Start in stage 1 and keep it going all game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt opens, then bring a scoped rifle, approach downwind so the animal does not bolt, and take the shot cleanly.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — grab every pack you pass as you play, and trade duplicates where you can. Three full sets is the goal, not every card in the game, so check which sets are closest and finish those first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The phone's WAiNK feature tags spots around the state — use it whenever the prompt appears and the count climbs on its own across the playthrough. Save a dedicated sweep for the last stretch, working district by district so you do not re-tag places.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges span combat, driving and activities, and the in-game challenge list shows what is left — knock out the easy ones first (driving and exploration challenges fall fast) and leave the combat ones for when your skills and weapons are better.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Use a fast car, break line of sight in the countryside or the swamps, and keep your partner with you — the escape only counts while you are together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — keep the heat on through all three, so plan a route of three close-together shops and a fast getaway car parked outside the third. If the heat drops between shops, start the run over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts — variety matters, so hop into anything unfamiliar instead of sticking to one favourite car. Parking lots, traffic and the Scooter Bros app are all good hunting grounds.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group — a gang hideout or a police response gives you the crowd — trigger focus, and chain headshots while it lasts. One clean run is all it takes.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a plane and take off without clearance. Expect a wanted level the moment you move; climb fast, leave airport airspace, and you are done once you are airborne and away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description only hints at Rhinos — the military tank — so expect this one to involve getting into, or surviving, a Rhino. Guide sites still list the exact trigger as unconfirmed, so check KeenGamer's and EGamers' updates; until then, treat any tank encounter as a chance and see what the game counts.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarms, no witnesses. Go at night, deal with the cameras first, take the goods quietly and leave before anything trips. If you are spotted, leave and retry: the trophy only counts a clean run.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — there are 8 vaults in total, so you only need five of them. Vaults open up through the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…': tail a security van into a bank while its vault is open, grab the cash, then escape the 4-star heat with a fast bike ready. GRADE NOTE: this guide lists the trophy Silver. KeenGamer, Insider Gaming, Radio Times and Exophase/PSNProfiles all say Silver; only Push Square lists it Bronze.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hit the truck, grab the cash, and break away before the response arrives — a fast car parked nearby turns a messy robbery into a clean getaway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map tracks the areas you have visited, so sweep the state region by region — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the countryside — and check the in-game map for the gaps that are left.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — nine gangs, per EGamers' list. One hit per gang is enough; scout each operation first so you know the guards and the way out before you go in.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a beach bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment, best done early while you are still learning the city.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive straight through the glass. Any showroom works; pick your car first, then leave through the window instead of the door.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a full game there. The description names that alley specifically, and GTA Vice City Hub notes one guide names a different alley, so use the Kolt & Associates one to be safe.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague and guide sites still list the exact trigger as unconfirmed — expect a co-op moment with your partner that draws a crowd. Check KeenGamer's updates as launch-era guides firm the method up, and do not force it: it will come from playing together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 choices for this trophy, so keep making story and open-world choices — dialogue picks, mission approaches, side decisions — and the total accumulates across the whole game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on your second try. If you fail a challenge or an attempt, retry it straight away instead of walking off; the retry is what counts.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy tied to something strange — guide sites list its method as unconfirmed. Watch for odd events while exploring, especially at night and off the beaten path; when something weird happens, the trophy is probably the point.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass, swing as you draw level, and keep the speed low enough to aim. Guides are still confirming the exact trigger, so if one pass does not count, vary the speed and the weapon.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies — launder them in chunks through your contacts and the total adds up. Bank-robbery money is the fastest feed, so this trophy follows naturally from the crime clean-up.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Big purchases count fastest — vehicles and gear — but everyday shopping adds up too, so buy what you use instead of saving for one giant spree.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties — KeenGamer counts eight. Garages go on sale as you progress; buy each one when it appears rather than leaving them all for the end, and the trophy pops with the last purchase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Drive a vehicle, open the app and register it — ten different vehicles does it. Combine this with the 100-vehicle discovery trophy: register the interesting ones as you find them.
